description: Fork-consumption site. On the stipulated homogeneous scale, QuartaViaDegreeFork.coverage gives the certified fork and QuartaViaUnboundedCore.incompatible excludes its unbounded horn under the added grades-to-maximum principle, leaving QuartaViaStrictCausalTop. Supplementary survivors obligation: the existing finite Boolean interpretation satisfies the fork background, the added principle and the strict top; the existing Nat interpretation satisfies the fork background and the unbounded horn and violates the added principle. The result is conditional and establishes no premise. It selects a top only under the listed background. It does not identify the top with God or with the maximally true, and adds no attribution to a source. The scale is a stipulated contrast reading and this result is off every root route.
